Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

crstools 1.2.0

  • implement plotting function for GCPs.
  • Allow to choose transformation method when georeferencing rasters.
  • Add get_pts_coords() function to georeference individual points with a chosen transformation method. Thin plate splines (transform_method = "tps") measure distances in the same way as GDAL, so that, with the default lambda = 0, points match the GDAL thin plate spline used by georeference_img().
  • Add get_gcp_residuals() function` to get the residuals of polynomials to assess the quality of the transformation.
  • suggest_crs() now accepts integer extents, stops with an error if an sf or SpatRaster object is in a projected CRS (reproject it to longitude/latitude first), assumes longitude/latitude with a warning if the object has no CRS, and honours quiet = TRUE for regional maps.
  • Fix the proj4 string of Winkel Tripel (which defined a different projection from the WKT when used by sf or terra) and the WKT of Hammer (which could not be parsed by PROJ).
  • Fix choose_gcp() and plot_gcp() swapping the width and height of non-square images, which led to incorrect georeferencing.
  • georeference_img() now works with images supplied as arrays, passes GCPs to GDAL without rounding them to 7 significant digits, and checks that there are enough GCPs for the chosen polynomial.
  • get_pts_coords() now stops if the GCPs contain missing values or cannot support the chosen polynomial.
  • Fix several bugs in extract_coords(), find_gcp_coords() and choose_gcp() when no points, or more points than needed, are clicked.
  • geom_tissot() now draws the indicatrices in every facet, and get_distortion_metrics() uses the same grid of centres as geom_tissot().

crstools 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
